answer: Give each identity a single public thread of work that only deepens: reward grows superlinearly with consecutive epochs of distinct, on-topic contributions along that thread, and a short unpredictable pulse window each epoch requires extending it with genuine new reasoning. A sybil operator splitting effort across many identities keeps every thread shallow and unpaid, while concentrating effort forfeits multiplicity. The accumulated thread becomes a harbor no copy can claim, because two identities presenting the same lineage fork visibly, and the fork earns nothing.
